findings.source_locator: sphere-models.tex paragraph after satisfaction definition; inheritance of non-vacuous clause to smaller spheres
findings.source_issue: A smaller sphere may contain no antecedent-true world, so the non-vacuous clause does not hold for every subsphere of a witnessing sphere.
findings.minimal_treatment: Restrict the statement to antecedent-admitting smaller spheres and qualify the innermost-sphere inference by existence; disclose adjacent to it.
